doc: Current die revisions the fleet-viz element table derives its element list from (tools/fleet_viz/die_contract_sync.py, FLEETVIZ-ELEM 2026-10-18; run hourly by fleet-viz-elem-sync.timer, output ~/.local/state/fleet-viz/die_contracts_live.json). Die leads: when a die revision lands, point 'ref' / the source paths here at it. Source kinds: port_bind (strict die port-bind JSON: masters{}), s81_bind_table (bind_table_<rev>.json: masters, child_views, child_views_owed, frame_members(+replaces), relay_views), hbm_contract (d4g compose contract: masters{}, instances notes 'remastered X -> Y', retired_v15), binding_replace (instances{from, master}), view_bindings (d4g view_bindings cells). A source reads <ref>:<path> (git), 'remote' host:path (ssh, cached) or 'file' (local path, .gz ok); the first readable alternative in 'any' wins. 'aliases' (old or die name -> job block / kit) and 'supersede' (old element -> successor) are curated additions to what the tool derives automatically. A source with use 'previous' is an older bind of the same die (its masters the current bind dropped are retired); 'annotate' only adds status to current masters. 'families' collapse GEN-generated masters with no job of their own into one family element (kits by kit_pattern). 'alias_rules' [[regex, replacement]] name renamed kit blocks.
